top_choice_rationale: P001 best combines a bounded virological discovery, mature preventive medical consequence, and a feasible three-person attribution. Confining the award to discoveries enabling virus-like-particle vaccines recognizes the central advance without assigning the named laureates credit for every later clinical-development or implementation contribution.
recusal_note: No conflict is apparent from the supplied profile. My documented work with Thomas Perlmann concerns other research subjects and does not establish involvement with this candidate.
